import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int INF = 1 << 29;
    static final int MAX_N = 500;

    static class Arc {
        int from, to, capacity, flow;
        Arc(int from, int to, int capacity, int flow) {
            this.from = from;
            this.to = to;
            this.capacity = capacity;
            this.flow = flow;
        }
    }

    static boolean[][] passable = new boolean[11][11];
    static List<Integer>[] graph = new ArrayList[MAX_N];
    static List<Arc> network = new ArrayList<>();
    static int[] level = new int[MAX_N];
    static int[] current = new int[MAX_N];
    static int grid_size, exit_row, exit_col, time_budget;
    static int[][] distances = new int[11][11];
    static int[][] capacities = new int[11][11];

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        
        for (int i = 0; i < MAX_N; i++) {
            graph[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
        
        grid_size = sc.nextInt();
        time_budget = sc.nextInt();
        
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        char ch;
        int node = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < grid_size; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < grid_size; ++j) {
                ch = sc.next().charAt(0);
                distances[i][j] = time_budget;
                if (ch == 'Z') {
                    exit_row = i;
                    exit_col = j;
                    passable[i][j] = false;
                } else if (ch == 'Y') {
                    passable[i][j] = false;
                } else {
                    passable[i][j] = true;
                }
                link(0, node++, (ch == 'Z' || ch == 'Y') ? 0 : ch - '0');
            }
        }
        
        node = grid_size * grid_size + 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < grid_size; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < grid_size; ++j) {
                ch = sc.next().charAt(0);
                if (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
                    capacities[i][j] = ch - '0';
                }
                link(node++, grid_size * grid_size * 2 + 1, (ch == 'Z' || ch == 'Y') ? 0 : ch - '0');
            }
        }
        
        q.offer(new int[]{0, exit_row, exit_col});
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int d = q.peek()[0];
            int r = q.peek()[1];
            int c = q.poll()[2];
            distances[r][c] = d;
            if (r > 0 && d + 1 < distances[r - 1][c] && passable[r - 1][c]) {
                q.offer(new int[]{d + 1, r - 1, c});
            }
            if (c > 0 && d + 1 < distances[r][c - 1] && passable[r][c - 1]) {
                q.offer(new int[]{d + 1, r, c - 1});
            }
            if (r < grid_size - 1 && d + 1 < distances[r + 1][c] && passable[r + 1][c]) {
                q.offer(new int[]{d + 1, r + 1, c});
            }
            if (c < grid_size - 1 && d + 1 < distances[r][c + 1] && passable[r][c + 1]) {
                q.offer(new int[]{d + 1, r, c + 1});
            }
        }
        
        int node_idx = 0;
        for (int r1 = 0; r1 < grid_size; ++r1) {
            for (int c1 = 0; c1 < grid_size; ++c1) {
                int sink_node = grid_size * grid_size;
                ++node_idx;
                for (int r2 = 0; r2 < grid_size; ++r2) {
                    for (int c2 = 0; c2 < grid_size; ++c2) {
                        ++sink_node;
                        if (passable[r1][c1] && passable[r2][c2] &&
                            compute_path_length(r1, c1, r2, c2) <= time_budget) {
                            link(node_idx, sink_node, INF);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        System.out.println(compute_maxflow());
    }

    static int compute_path_length(int src_r, int src_c, int dst_r, int dst_c) {
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(new int[]{0, src_r, src_c});
        int[][] dist_map = new int[11][11];
        for (int i = 0; i < 11; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 11; ++j) {
                dist_map[i][j] = INF;
            }
        }
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int dist = q.peek()[0];
            int r = q.peek()[1];
            int c = q.poll()[2];
            dist_map[r][c] = dist;
            if (r > 0 && passable[r-1][c]) {
                int nr = r - 1, nc = c;
                if (dist_map[nr][nc] > dist + 1) {
                    boolean ok1 = (nr == dst_r && nc == dst_c && distances[nr][nc] >= dist + 1);
                    boolean ok2 = (!(nr == dst_r && nc == dst_c) && distances[nr][nc] > dist + 1);
                    if (ok1 || ok2) {
                        q.offer(new int[]{dist + 1, nr, nc});
                    }
                }
            }
            if (c > 0 && passable[r][c-1]) {
                int nr = r, nc = c - 1;
                if (dist_map[nr][nc] > dist + 1) {
                    boolean ok1 = (nr == dst_r && nc == dst_c && distances[nr][nc] >= dist + 1);
                    boolean ok2 = (!(nr == dst_r && nc == dst_c) && distances[nr][nc] > dist + 1);
                    if (ok1 || ok2) {
                        q.offer(new int[]{dist + 1, nr, nc});
                    }
                }
            }
            if (r < 10 && passable[r+1][c]) {
                int nr = r + 1, nc = c;
                if (dist_map[nr][nc] > dist + 1) {
                    boolean ok1 = (nr == dst_r && nc == dst_c && distances[nr][nc] >= dist + 1);
                    boolean ok2 = (!(nr == dst_r && nc == dst_c) && distances[nr][nc] > dist + 1);
                    if (ok1 || ok2) {
                        q.offer(new int[]{dist + 1, nr, nc});
                    }
                }
            }
            if (c < 10 && passable[r][c+1]) {
                int nr = r, nc = c + 1;
                if (dist_map[nr][nc] > dist + 1) {
                    boolean ok1 = (nr == dst_r && nc == dst_c && distances[nr][nc] >= dist + 1);
                    boolean ok2 = (!(nr == dst_r && nc == dst_c) && distances[nr][nc] > dist + 1);
                    if (ok1 || ok2) {
                        q.offer(new int[]{dist + 1, nr, nc});
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return dist_map[dst_r][dst_c];
    }

    static void link(int u, int v, int cap) {
        network.add(new Arc(u, v, cap, 0));
        network.add(new Arc(v, u, 0, 0));
        graph[u].add(network.size() - 2);
        graph[v].add(network.size() - 1);
    }

    static boolean construct_levels() {
        Arrays.fill(level, -1);
        Queue<Integer> queue = new LinkedList<>();
        queue.offer(0);
        level[0] = 0;
        while (!queue.isEmpty() && level[grid_size * grid_size * 2 + 1] == -1) {
            int u = queue.poll();
            for (int idx : graph[u]) {
                Arc arc = network.get(idx);
                int v = arc.to;
                if (level[v] == -1 && arc.flow < arc.capacity) {
                    level[v] = level[u] + 1;
                    queue.offer(v);
                }
            }
        }
        return level[grid_size * grid_size * 2 + 1] != -1;
    }

    static int send_flow(int u, int limit) {
        if (limit == 0) return 0;
        if (u == grid_size * grid_size * 2 + 1) return limit;
        for (; current[u] < graph[u].size(); ++current[u]) {
            int idx = graph[u].get(current[u]);
            Arc arc = network.get(idx);
            int v = arc.to;
            if (level[v] != level[u] + 1) continue;
            int augment = send_flow(v, Math.min(limit, arc.capacity - arc.flow));
            if (augment != 0) {
                arc.flow += augment;
                network.get(idx ^ 1).flow -= augment;
                return augment;
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    static int compute_maxflow() {
        int flow = 0;
        while (construct_levels()) {
            Arrays.fill(current, 0);
            int delta;
            while ((delta = send_flow(0, INF)) != 0) {
                flow += delta;
            }
        }
        return flow;
    }
}
